question: What powers arise from this practice regarding distant hearing and bondage?
premises: One power is hearing from afar
Another power is the paralysis of bonds
inference: The practice grants knowledge of distant hearing and the power to paralyze bonds
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may mean arresting or immobilizing bonds
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
